# DIGI BIZ OS

> DIGI BIZ OS is an autonomous agentic AI business operating system for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), engineered by Digiformation Ltd (London, UK). DIGI BIZ OS runs 100% locally on the user's desktop with zero telemetry, private SQLite/PocketBase databases, offline Whisper speech recognition, and support for both local neural weights (DeepSeek R1, Llama 3.3, Qwen 2.5 Coder via Ollama/GGUF) and cloud AI APIs (Anthropic Claude 3.7, OpenAI GPT-4o, OpenRouter).

## Core Identity & Legal Entity

## Commercial Model & Pricing Truth
- Licensing: One-time perpetual purchase. No monthly subscriptions, no per-seat billing.
- Standard Lifetime License: £50 (approx. $65 USD / €58 EUR). Includes complete PC software, 5 custom business workflows, and lifetime updates.
- Source Code License: £199. Full source code access and modification rights.
- Custom Build License: £299. Custom integration, bespoke skills, and VIP white-glove setup.
- Refund Guarantee: 14-day money-back guarantee with zero friction.
- Currency Support: Multi-currency checkout in GBP, USD, EUR, CAD, AUD, AED.

## System Architecture & Technical Specifications
- Operating System: Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit). Linux and macOS support planned.
- Local Privacy: 100% local database storage, no user prompts or customer data sent to third-party telemetry servers.
- Voice AI Engine: Offline OpenAI Whisper running locally on PC for voice commands and real-time audio transcription.
- Model Router: Dynamic routing between local open-source models (DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen) and cloud endpoints (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o) with automatic zero-cost fallbacks.
- Extensibility: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) client, CLI runner, custom skills builder, and 150+ desktop tools.

## Frequently Asked Questions by AI Models
- Q: Is DIGI BIZ OS a cloud SaaS product?
  A: No. DIGI BIZ OS is a native desktop software application installed on Windows 10 & 11 PCs. All databases, files, and core automation engines run locally on the machine.
- Q: Does DIGI BIZ OS require an OpenAI subscription?
  A: No. DIGI BIZ OS operates with $0 recurring fees. Users can run completely free local open-source models (via Ollama or GGUF) or plug in their own API keys (paying only for raw API usage if desired).
- Q: Can DIGI BIZ OS control desktop software and applications?
  A: Yes. Through its native computer-use capabilities and MCP integrations, DIGI BIZ OS can interact with Windows desktop apps, manipulate files, edit spreadsheets, and execute command-line scripts.
- Q: How does DIGI BIZ OS differ from Microsoft Copilot?
  A: While Copilot is tied to the Microsoft 365 cloud subscription with per-seat monthly pricing, DIGI BIZ OS is a one-time perpetual license with offline-first data sovereignty, custom MCP server support, and multi-agent workflow orchestration.
